completed_tasks.result: CPU matches llama.cpp. CUDA divergence was isolated to CUDA-specific full-model output.

completed_tasks.name: Pin CUDA IQ4_XS sidecar root cause
completed_tasks.result: The divergence was caused by the CUDA Q5_K dequant layout used by IQ4_XS models, not cumulative FP16 activation precision. Q5_K stores four 64-element pairs; CUDA now indexes pair_idx=sub>>1, nibble_half=sub&1, and qh bit=sub.

completed_tasks.name: Remove default CPU correctness fallback and restore fast CUDA forward
completed_tasks.result: High-precision IQ fallback is now opt-in via DOTLLM_ENABLE_HIGH_PRECISION_IQUANTS=1. The default path disposes CPU weights after upload and runs CUDA kernels directly.

decisions.decision: Treat Q5_K dequant layout as the IQ4_XS sidecar root cause
decisions.rationale: Layer diagnostics showed IQ4_XS components matched until tensors using Q5_K were projected. Correcting Q5_K dequant brought the full llama.cpp sidecar into tolerance.

decisions.decision: Keep high-precision IQ forward as opt-in only
decisions.rationale: The corrected CUDA path is accurate and fast. Retaining CPU weights by default would regress load/runtime memory and decode performance.

decisions.decision: Gate real GGUF and perf tests by local fixtures and explicit env vars
decisions.rationale: GGUF weights are too large to commit. Tests should run automatically on developer/CUDA hosts with cached fixtures and skip cleanly elsewhere.
